snippet.title: Robo Frenzy - Jules Boss Reveal - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
This exclusive new trailer for sandbox boss-battler Robo Frenzy highlights the different bosses in the game, how players can customize them, and even a special Future Game Show crossover featuring our very own Jules Gill! 

A playable demo is available on Steam. Robo Frenzy is coming to PC, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch next year. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #robofrenzy
